l-e-e6-b05-19.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad akhrido khudbad 3 daqiiqo. Haddii aad akhrido ku dhawaad 120 eray 1 daqiiqo gudaheeda, qiyaas ku dhawaad imisa eray ayay khudbaddu waa inay leedahay.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s1.prompt: Waa kee tirada erayada ku habboon khudbadda?
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s1.r.a: 120 waxaa lagu qaybiyey 3. Waa inaad ku dhuftaa.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: 3 ayaa lagu daray 120. Waa 3 daqiiqo, sidaas darteed waa inaad ku dhuftaa.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu leeyahay hal god oo dheeraad ah. 120 × 3 waa ka yar yahay 400.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s1.explain: Qiyaastii 120 erey 1 daqiiqo macnaheedu waa 120 × 3 = 360 3 daqiiqo, sidaa darteed waa qiyaastii 360 erey.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: Waxaad akhrisaa qiyaastii 120 erey 1 daqiiqo, 3 jeer, sidaa darteed qiyaastii 360 erey waa jawaabta saxda ah.
l-e-e6-b05-19.s.s2.model.1: Ku darista 120 3 jeer waxay siinaysaa qiyaastii 360, sidaa darteed doorashooyinka kale aad bay u yar yihiin ama u weyn yihiin.

l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah waqtiga akhrinta ee ku habboon?
l-e-e6-b05-20.title: Qiyaasidda waqtiga akhrinta 1 sano gudahood
l-e-e6-b05-20.goal: Qiyaas waqtiga lagu akhriyo 3 jeer toddobaadkii 15 daqiiqo mar kasta 1 sano si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-e-e6-b05-20.material: Waxaan akhriyaa buug Ingiriisi ah 3 jeer toddobaadkii, 15 daqiiqo mar kasta. Haddii aan sidan u akhriyo 1 sano (52 toddobaad), qiyaas qiyaastii imisa saacadood ayay noqonaysaa wadar ahaan.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waa qiyaastii qiimaha waqtiga hal bil. 1 sano way ka badan tahay.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu leeyahay hal god oo dheeraad ah. Waa qadar akhris oo ka badan 1 saacad maalin kasta.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s1.r.d: 3 × 15 × 52 si khaldan ayaa loo qiyaasay. Way ka badan tahay.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s1.explain: 3 × 15 = 45 daqiiqo waa waqtiga la akhriyo 1 toddobaad. 45 daqiiqo × 52 waa qiyaastii 2,340 daqiiqo, taasoo ah qiyaastii 39 saacadood.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s2.model.0: 1 toddobaad waa 45 daqiiqo waxaana jira 52 toddobaad, sidaa darteed taasi waa qiyaastii 2,340 daqiiqo; qaybinta 60, qiyaastii 40 saacadood waa jawaabta saxda ah.
l-e-e6-b05-20.s.s2.model.1: Qiyaasidda 45 daqiiqo 50 toddobaad waxay siinaysaa qiyaastii 2,250 daqiiqo, taasoo ah qiyaastii 37 saacadood, sidaa darteed qiyaastii 40 saacadood waa jawaabta saxda ah.

l-e-e6-b06-16.material: Hal bog oo buug erayo ah waxaa ku jira 12 eray. Buuggu wuxuu leeyahay 38 bog wadar ahaan. Qiyaas ku dhawaad imisa eray ayaa wadar ahaan jira.

l-e-e6-b06-16.s.s1.explain: Haddii aad 12 u malayso 10, 38 bog waxay leeyihiin ku dhawaad 380 eray, maadaama runtii ay tahay 12, wax yar ayaa ka badan, ku dhawaad 450 eray. Si sax ah, waa 456 eray.
l-e-e6-b06-16.s.s2.model.0: 12 eray hal bog iyo 38 bog, waa ku dhawaad 12 × 38, ama ku dhawaad 450 eray, sidaas darteed ku dhawaad 450 eray waa sax.
l-e-e6-b06-16.s.s2.model.1: Ku dhuftidda 12 waxay bixisaa wax ka badan 400 oo ka yar 500, sidaas darteed ku dhawaad 450 eray waa sax.
